## Europe

[FIELD NOTES / A DIFFERENT PACE]{.project-label}

I spent three years of my adolesent life living in different parts of europe.Those years shaped me to be the person I am today.

From ages fifteen to sixteen I lived in a small town in switzerlannd called montreux. While living there I had the oppurtunity to embrace myself into their culture and learn French.from ages sixteen to eighteen I lived in mallorca Spain a beautiful island with its own unique history. I learned about the orgins of mallorca and how they became a part of spain. Since I already speak spanish I was truly able to connect with the people there.

## What I want to remember

- The details that a photograph doesn't capture.
- A question about the place or the people who live there.
- Something I would notice differently on a return visit.
